method: Authenticated ISO9660/CD load descriptor and retail loader value flow; independently corroborated by native-entry delta fingerprint

load_map.basis: Core func_800196E4 writes header[0] = source.end_pointer - 0x8001DCCC + 4 and registers this header under the masked key. Town func_8008AF2C returns the registered pointer; func_8008AFB0 passes it and D_801131E4 to func_80053CFC. That wrapper copies length/LBA, packs ceil(length/0x800) into bits 23..31 and destination into bits 0..22. Control_CD case 6 reads exactly that many sectors at header[1] directly into the KSEG0 destination. There is no decompressor or relocation in this transfer.

core_prerequisite_map.basis: Resident change_map selects D_800812F8 in pending state D_8006ADEC+4 for non-12 scene state when callback data is non-null. func_8003BD34 copies the pending state to D_8006ADBC; func_80053C6C forwards its +4 word to func_80053C3C, which submits Control_CD command 6 and waits. The descriptor decodes to a 19-sector read into 0x80016000. Town func_8009D5C0 publishes D_801131B8 at 0x80016000 before running the init bytecode. The matching core header invokes func_8001A484, which sets state+0x2C to 0x8001DCD0 and state+0x34 to the CD-header table.

formula: foff_start = (CD_LBA - TOWN_ISO_LBA) * 0x800; delta = KSEG0_destination - foff_start; true_vma = row_foff + delta
limits: Static retail placement evidence; no runtime trace is claimed.
No assigned body contains an in-row local-j or switch-table witness. A leaf recompile alone does not determine placement. The independently decoded CD load determines the base.
Generated script headers are registered conditionally as their object groups are initialized. This proof identifies the transfer when selected; it does not assert a particular scene was observed.
The two script banks share a cache slot. The stated destination is the front slot used by the CD transfer, not permanent simultaneous residency of every bank.
The rowbase extent grants placement only. It does not transfer ownership of script bytes, neighboring routines, cache storage, or imported tables.
